errors.trigger: Missing, repeated, conflicting, or unsupported command arguments.
errors.remediation: Use the exact command help contract.

errors.trigger: A JSON input is not one object.
Input, semantic result, private gate, or output violates its declared schema or route invariant.
errors.remediation: Repair the value to match the declared Delivery Review contract.

errors.trigger: A repository-relative locator is missing, escapes its owner root, or is symlink-backed.
errors.remediation: Use a regular file below the declared repository or package root.

errors.trigger: Task, branch, worktree, HEAD, base, or gate identity changed after review.
errors.remediation: Repeat Delivery Review from current live facts.

errors.trigger: An unexpected package runtime failure occurred.
errors.remediation: Inspect the package-local runtime and retry.
